items.text: Arizona RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle), out the last two games, was set to practice in a limited role Wednesday; status TBD. TE Tip Reiman (ankle) is out and RB James Conner is on IR. Jacoby Brissett starts.

Dallas (Wednesday walkthrough, estimated): WR KaVontae Turpin (ribs) and LB Dee Winters (calf) did not practice; WR George Pickens (shoulder/hamstring), DT Quinnen Williams (hamstring) and S Caleb Downs (ankle) were limited.
